final: SELECT AVG(avg_PT) as final_avg_PT, AVG(avg_TAT_diff) as final_avg_TAT_diff FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) as avg_PT, AVG(TAT - TAT2) as avg_TAT_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) AND ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ID)
